root_cause: payments-stub became slow (responses take seconds), so checkout-api calls time out and return 504s.
evidence: metric:latency_p99_ms of checkout-api jumps to the timeout
metric:error_rate_percent rises on checkout-api while its own CPU and memory stay normal
recommended_remediation: Fix or fail over payments-stub; meanwhile enable a circuit breaker or fallback in checkout-api. Do not restart checkout-api.
risk_rationale: The fix is in a dependency; changing checkout-api configuration is medium risk.
